newsitem.title: UK: UK's Worthington buys Ibex and Whitely.
newsitem.headline: UK's Worthington buys Ibex and Whitely.

text.p: British textile industry supplier Worthington Group Plc said on Thursday it bought Ibex Ropes Ltd and Whitely Products Ltd for 4.375 million stg.
Worthington said it would aim to raise around 3.8 million stg net of expenses in a three-for-13 placing and open offer of 7,662,593 new ordinary shares at 54p each.
The balance of the costs of Ibex and Whitely would be paid out of existing resources, Worthington said.
The company said Ibex and Whitely produce specialised cord and rope products, exercise equipment and kites.
